server.gh_docker_mode_helper:
Docker: each job gets a private Docker daemon. The daemon runs privileged, so a job can get root access to this server. Use it only for trusted repositories.

Isolated Docker: each job gets a private Docker daemon in an unprivileged Sysbox container. Everything that needs Docker works, and root in the job has no rights on this server. Needs Sysbox on the server.

No Docker: jobs run in an unprivileged container. JavaScript actions, composite actions, and shell steps work. Docker container actions, services, container jobs, and docker commands fail.

The host Docker socket is never shared.
